_comment: frontend.md §2.4 rule 3: which feature owns each JE.internals slot. Only a host file of an owning feature (features/<f>/host*.ts) may touch a slot. Evidence: the file that creates the slot. 'features' is created by both details-providers (details-page.ts, media-info.ts, release-dates.ts) and hidden-content (hidden-content/host.ts, features-remove-home.ts), so both own it until C3 splits it. 'enhancedUi' (step C4, coordinator decision D1) is the settings registry: settings-panel's shell and the Media Tags and Hidden Content panels (moved out in A1/A2, and loaded without the shell by unit and browser tests) each create it on first use and fill their own members, and media-tags' admin page, admin sections and item editor read those members back, so all three co-own that slot only.
